name: ai-cli-ref
description: Send file references to AI CLI terminals (Claude Code, Qoder CLI, etc.)

commands.title: Insert File Reference to AI CLI Terminal

ai-cli-ref.terminalNames.description: Terminal name patterns to target. Matching is case-insensitive; '*' matches any number of characters and '?' matches one character.

ai-cli-ref.pathMode.description: Path mode for file references. 'absolute' uses the full filesystem path (default); 'relative' uses the path relative to the workspace root.

ai-cli-ref.keybinding.description: Default keybinding hint (actual binding is set via Keyboard Shortcuts UI: search 'ai-cli-ref.send')
